# gigahost_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up a single DNS zone by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gigahost_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.no"
}

output "zone_id" {
  value = data.gigahost_dns_zone.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Zone ID.
- `name` (String) Zone (domain) name.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) True when the zone is active.
- `external_dns` (Boolean) True when the zone is served by external nameservers.
- `is_registered` (Boolean) True when the domain is registered through Gigahost.
- `protected` (Boolean) True when the zone is registered and cannot be deleted through the API.
- `record_count` (Number) Number of records in the zone.
- `registrar` (String) Domain registrar, when the domain is registered.
- `type` (String) Zone type: `NATIVE`, `MASTER` or `SLAVE`.
- `updated_at` (Number) When the zone was last updated (Unix seconds).
